description: Move with flow, allow the truth to find you. #selflove #choosepeace #selfpeace
transcript: The future will reveal itself, and it'll never be what we expect it to be. It is so important to see people at face value, not what we wish them to be. The more that we take control and responsibility of ourselves, we can become initiators. We can make the first move. Even if that first move is moving out of the way, you have to be willing to take control.
